newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: Abu Dhabi to supply gas to Dubai.
newsitem.headline: Abu Dhabi to supply gas to Dubai.

text.p: The emirates of Abu Dhabi and Dubai in the United Arab Emirates are working on plans to transport gas from Abu Dhabi offshore fields to Dubai, UAE acting Oil Minister Rakad bin Salem bin Rakad said on Monday.
"There is an understanding," Rakad replied to a question whether the two emirates were in talks for a gas supply deal.
the minister said the project was currently under review, but declined to give any details. He was talking to reporters on the sidelines of a gas conference here.

Industry sources say Abu Dhabi is already advanced in its plans to further develop its offshore Ummm Shaif and the Abu al-Bukhoosh fields to supply some 600 million cubic feet a day to the Jebel Ali industrial zone in Dubai.
Dubai, a small Gulf oil producer, is facing a shortfall in its gas requirements in the next decade, industry sources said.
It has been in negotiations with Qatar and Iran for gas supplies, but it now seems it will secure most of its future gas needs from Abu Dhabi.
The Abu Dhabi-Dubai gas plan involves developing the non-associated Khuff gas reserves in the two offshore fields.
The minister's statement was the clearest indication to date that the two emirates will increase their gas relationship.
